app.name: MevaCare AI Health Companion
app.tagline: Your personal health intelligence, explained calmly.
app.disclaimer: MevaCare provides wellness information only. It does not diagnose, prescribe or replace a doctor. In an emergency call your local emergency number (112 in the EU).

privacy.title: Privacy & Consent
privacy.subtitle: You decide how your data is used. Every change is recorded in an audit log.

TermsOfService.title: Terms of Service and Privacy Policy
TermsOfService.body: Required to have an account. It can only be withdrawn by deleting the account.

HealthDataProcessing.title: Health data processing
HealthDataProcessing.body: Allows MevaCare to store and use your health profile, goals, nutrition and measurements. Without it those features stay locked.

AiProcessing.title: AI processing
AiProcessing.body: Allows sending your chat messages, and only the context needed to answer them, to the configured AI provider.

ExternalIntegrations.title: External integrations
ExternalIntegrations.body: Allows connecting wearables (WHOOP) and importing their data.

privacy.exportBody: Download everything MevaCare stores about you as a JSON file.
privacy.deleteBody: Permanently deletes your account and all associated data. This cannot be undone. A minimal audit record without personal data is kept for security.

aiSettings.title: AI Settings
aiSettings.subtitle: Control how the AI companion may use your information.
aiSettings.consentOffHelp: The AI companion is disabled until you allow AI processing.
aiSettings.whatIsSentTitle: What is sent to the AI provider
aiSettings.whatIsSent1: The messages you type in the chat and recent messages from the same conversation.
aiSettings.whatIsSent2: Short safety and style instructions written by MevaCare.
aiSettings.whatIsSent3: Never your e-mail address, password, tokens or your complete profile.
aiSettings.limits1: The assistant gives wellness information. It does not diagnose, prescribe or change medication.
aiSettings.limits2: It can make mistakes. Check important information with a qualified professional.
aiSettings.providerBody: The model provider is configured on the server by the operator of this installation.
aiSettings.knowledgeBody: When you ask about health terms or guidance, the assistant can answer from these approved documents and cites them. It never uses other sources for those answers.
aiSettings.knowledgeEmpty: No approved sources are indexed yet, so the assistant has no reference documents.
aiSettings.whatIsSent4: When your question needs your own data, only the matching facts the assistant looks up for that answer: profile basics (age, sex, height, activity level), nutrition totals, weight entries, and sleep and recovery values from a connected device.

insights.title: Insights
insights.subtitle: Trends and comparisons calculated from your own recorded data. They describe what the data shows, not why, and they are not medical advice.

coverage.title: What this is based on
coverage.line: {{from}} to {{to}}: {{weight}} weight entries, meals logged on {{logged}} of {{window}} days.
coverage.provider: {{provider}}: sleep on {{sleep}} days, recovery on {{recovery}} days.

sections.compare: This period compared with the {{days}} days before

insights.none: Nothing stands out in this period.
insights.trendsNote: A trend is the average change per week fitted through your data. A weak fit or few days lowers the confidence.

notes.needs_3_points_over_7_days: A trend needs at least 3 days with data spread over 7 days or more.

caveats.association_not_cause: Things that change together are not necessarily connected: this shows an association, not a cause.
caveats.weight_varies_daily: Weight normally varies from day to day (water, salt, timing).
caveats.low_confidence: Low confidence: few days or a loose fit, so treat this as a hint.
caveats.logging_gaps: Meals were logged on fewer than half of the days, so nutrition numbers may not describe the other days.
caveats.incomplete_food_data: Some foods have unknown nutrient values, so totals may be too low.
caveats.provider_score: This is the device provider's own score, compared only with your own history.
caveats.small_sample: Based on a small number of days.

limitations.observational_only: Everything here is observed in your own data. It cannot show what caused a change.
limitations.not_medical_advice: This is wellness information, not medical advice. Talk to a qualified professional about health concerns.
limitations.provider_scores_not_comparable: Scores from a device (recovery, strain) belong to that device and are never compared with other devices.
limitations.logging_gaps: Nutrition averages use only the days you logged meals.

compare.note: Averages of the days that have data in each period. A difference is highlighted only when it is bigger than usual day-to-day variation.

explain.title: Explain it in plain words
explain.body: The AI puts the numbers above into words. It only receives these calculated insights, may not add numbers of its own, and is checked for numbers that are not in your data.

explain.ungroundedBody: These numbers in the text could not be matched to your data: {{numbers}}. Rely on the cards above.
explain.disclaimer: AI-written from calculated values. It can still phrase things badly. Wellness information, not medical advice.
